children.name: Convert Short text to date if possible

authorized_error_ratios.description: Over this ratios, the column will not be converted into date

sample_size.description: Convert date is time consuming.                     To save time, date detection will be done on a random sample.                     Set to -1 to detect on the whole dataset

children.name: Drop numerical columns
children.description:
Drop numerical columns where the proportion of empty rows
        in the dataset is higher than {empty_threshold}.

empty_threshold.description: Column with more or equal proportion of empty row                     will dropped. 1 will drop all columns

children.name: Fill missing values with mean
children.description:
Fills missing values with the mean of non-missing values
        when the proportion of empty rows is lower than {empty_threshold}.

empty_threshold.description: Column with less or equal proportion of empty row will                     be fill with mean value. 1 will always fill void values

children.name: Remove High Correlated Column
children.description: Remove columns which correlation with other columns is higher than {threshold}.

threshold.description: If two columns is correlated over this value, only one                     will be kept
